intent: The floating creation toolbar: tool groups (Move/Hand, Frame, Shape, Type) as a pill; each group's button reflects its last-used tool and shows an active state when any of its tools is selected.
use_when: The canvas-level tool switcher for an editor.
dont_use_when: Inspector controls — this is a canvas tool pill.

tokens.note: DS tokens only; no hardcoded hex — verified.

a11y.tools: each group button reflects the last-used tool; a menu exposes the group's variants.
a11y.memory: tool memory is UI-only — it never enters the document or the host undo stack.
